plan.scope: Reused384 validation prompts, b64 greedy; matched model/backend; instrumented full-verification diagnostic only.
plan.hypothesis: Determine whether the confidence forecasts leave decision-relevant headroom before more online-fitting sweeps.
plan.protocol: Admit every available draft (up to7); snapshot head confidence before target-feedback observation; attach actual accepted prefixes by persistent slot. All outputs must match AR.
plan.oracle: Post-hoc one-step full-information ceiling on these recorded full-verification states, using same profiled cost table. Not causal/deployable and not a closed-loop speedup bound. Do not use oracle labels in a claimed online policy.
plan.report: Head-budget decisions vs fixed7 and oracle budgets, realized accepted-token/profile-cost ratios, all domains. Different policies change future states; replay cannot prove wall-time speedup.
plan.correctness: Assert each scheduled capacity equals sampled-minus-one plus rejected, map feedback byslot, no unmatched records. Preserve failure outputs.

target_costs.scope: Only target-cost table changes at/below graph limit; native confidence head, scheduler and sampler preserved
